text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It really is nice and quiet at this hour.
No need to worry about anyone else... Hm?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
You're quite the diligent one, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-chan.
Because I want to become even stronger, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right!
Could I challenge you to a quick match right now?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! 
You really are... strong...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I understand your pursuit of strength, but you're rushing things a bit.
Is there a reason for your haste?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ......It's Brian-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Unlike me, who only just debuted this year... Brian-chan keeps charging further and further ahead.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I can't just keep standing still like this.
If I do... I won't even be able to see their backs anymore.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
............
The brilliance of the truly gifted can sometimes blind those who dare draw near them...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“...Join me for morning practice starting tomorrow.
I will watch your running myself.”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You need to know your exact standing.

It has been one week since Sakura Laurel
began receiving coaching from Biwa Hayahide—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Not bad.
Lap times are up nearly 0.5 seconds
compared to a week ago.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... In just one week, to see such clear
results—
Oooooooooohhh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: That's...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It made the time I spent a whole week shaving off
look like nothing at all...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I guess... it really is still a long way off.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Are you familiar with the fable of the Tortoise and the Hare?
The one where the slacker is overtaken by the diligent worker.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Um... Y-Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Think about what would have happened in that story...
if the hare hadn't slacked off."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...The tortoise has no path to victory.
Naturally. The biological foundation is simply different."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Brian is, so to speak...
a hare that doesn't slack off.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right.
So what am I right now—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I am no tortoise; I am the same hare. Merely one that got a late start.
Since we are biologically the same species,
the only thing that separates our growth is the total sum of effort.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "To believe in one's own growth"...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "Trial and error on the path to your goal"...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Through the effort of stacking all of those up,
your growth will eventually 'take shape.'"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even if each individual layer of achievement is thin,
countless stacked layers provide dependable strength.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"As long as the total sum of my compounded efforts keeps coming out ahead...
even if I get a late start, I'm bound to catch up eventually."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you,
Hayahide-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(The sheer weight of what accumulates over time...
she may come to understand it even better than I do someday.)
While keeping a close watch over Sakura Laurel, I incorporated the insights gained from this experience into our growth strategy.
